description: Held-out evaluation corpus for Secret Leak Detector. Run 'npm run benchmark:heldout' to reproduce.

methodology.corpusSeparation: This corpus was created after the detector rules were finalized. No cases from this corpus were used to tune detector thresholds or patterns.
methodology.labellingProcess: Each case was labelled by the author. TP = credential matching a known provider pattern. TN = high-entropy non-secret (hash, UUID, JWT example, etc.)
methodology.seed: N/A — held-out corpus is deterministic (fixed strings)
methodology.reproducibilityNote: Clone the repository, run 'npm ci && npm run build && npm run benchmark:heldout'. Results should match within rounding error.

expectedResults.note: Fill in after running npm run benchmark:heldout on a clean checkout.

independentReproduction.instructions: 1. Clone the repository. 2. Run 'npm ci'. 3. Run 'npm run build'. 4. Run 'npm run benchmark:heldout'. 5. Compare confusion-matrix counts to expectedResults above. 6. Report any discrepancy as a GitHub Issue.
